overview: ST-SimDiff is a training-free framework for efficient video understanding that constructs a spatiotemporal graph of visual tokens and applies a dual-selection strategy (similarity-based representative token selection and difference-based event token selection) to compress tokens while preserving both static and dynamic content.

modules.name: Video Preprocessing and Token Extraction
modules.description: Handles video loading, frame sampling, and feature extraction using a pre-trained vision encoder to obtain a sequence of visual tokens.

modules.name: Spatiotemporal Graph Builder
modules.description: Constructs a graph where nodes represent visual tokens and edges connect spatially adjacent tokens within the same frame and temporally adjacent tokens across frames, with edge weights as cosine similarity.

modules.name: Graph Thresholding and Community Detector
modules.description: Filters graph edges based on a similarity threshold and identifies connected components (or communities) of highly similar tokens.

modules.name: Representative Token Selector (SRTS)
modules.description: For each community, computes centrality scores (average similarity to other tokens in the community) and selects the top tokens based on a retention ratio.

modules.name: Event Token Selector (DETS)
modules.description: Examines temporal edges for sharp similarity drops below a difference threshold and marks tokens at turning points as critical event tokens.

modules.name: Token Merger and Pruner
modules.description: Combines the selected representative and event tokens, then prunes any excess tokens based on attention scores from shallow LLM layers to meet a target token count.

modules.name: LVLM Adapter
modules.description: Interfaces with existing large vision-language models (e.g., LLaVA-Video, NVILA) to replace the original visual token sequence with the compressed token subset for efficient inference.

modules.name: Inference Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates the entire pipeline from video input to final answer generation, integrating token extraction, graph-based selection, and LVLM inference.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluator
modules.description: Loads benchmark datasets (VideoMME, LongVideoBench, EgoSchema), runs inference, computes accuracy metrics, and compares performance against baselines.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configures experiments to isolate the contribution of each component (SRTS, DETS) by enabling/disabling them and measuring performance changes.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Tuner
modules.description: Performs sensitivity analysis on key hyperparameters (similarity threshold, difference threshold) by systematically varying their values and evaluating performance on validation sets.

modules.name: Computational Profiler
modules.description: Measures inference time and GPU memory usage for different video lengths and compression ratios, providing efficiency comparisons against baseline models.

modules.name: Visualization Toolkit
modules.description: Generates visual explanations of the token selection process, highlighting representative and event tokens on video frames for interpretability.

modules.name: Configuration Manager
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations (hyperparameters, model choices, paths) via YAML/JSON files, ensuring reproducibility and easy experimentation.

modules.name: Result Reporter
modules.description: Aggregates performance metrics, computational costs, and ablation results into formatted tables and charts, generating LaTeX-ready outputs for publication.
